usage: save_plan.py [-h] --title TITLE [--content CONTENT] [--file FILE]
                    [--project PROJECT] [--dir DIR] [--id ID]
                    [--session-id SESSION_ID] [--version VERSION]
                    [--tags TAGS] [--milestones MILESTONES]
                    [--status {draft,planned,active,in_progress,completed,superseded}]
                    [--parent-id PARENT_ID] [--supersedes SUPERSEDES]
                    [--kind {feature,bug}] [--backlog-items BACKLOG_ITEMS]
                    [--spec-dir SPEC_DIR]

Save an uncompressed architecture plan or roadmap to docs/plans

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE         Plan title / headline
  --content CONTENT     Inline markdown content
  --file FILE           Path to markdown/text file containing the plan
  --project PROJECT     Project name (default: .dev-cycle.json project_name or
                        repository folder name)
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current; the Git root is
                        used)
  --id ID               Explicit unique Plan ID (auto-generated if omitted)
  --session-id SESSION_ID
                        Conversation ID where the plan was conceived
  --version VERSION     Target software version (e.g. v0.30.37)
  --tags TAGS           Comma-separated keywords/tags
  --milestones MILESTONES
                        Comma-separated milestone targets
  --status {draft,planned,active,in_progress,completed,superseded}
                        Plan status
  --parent-id PARENT_ID
                        Parent plan ID for hierarchical breakdown
  --supersedes SUPERSEDES
                        Older Plan ID that this new plan supersedes
  --kind {feature,bug}  Plan kind (default: feature)
  --backlog-items BACKLOG_ITEMS
                        Comma-separated backlog item ids the plan delivers
  --spec-dir SPEC_DIR   Spec Kit folder with the plan's detail (e.g.
                        specs/001-photo-upload)
